source.dataset: OpenStreetMap highway ways from the committed osm-highways.json snapshot
source.profile: pedestrian, bidirectional approximation with nearest-segment snapping
source.limitation: BAG points and container anchors are connected to their nearest eligible OSM segment by a straight access leg; this remains a screening model, not a surveyed door-to-container route.

graph.snapMethod: nearest eligible segment with projected along-segment distance
